name: Real Activity/Matching/Rust Bridge
prerequisites: Running Temporal Server with CHASM OntoFlowLibrary registered
Running Rust Worker polling onto-loop-v0 task queue
Ability to start a single-WorkItem OntoFlow

acceptance_tests.test: Temporal Server starts with OntoFlowLibrary registered
Rust Worker polls and receives task
acceptance_tests.assert: LoopInvocationRequest fields match: flow_id, work_item_id, loop_id, request_binding_hash

acceptance_tests.test: Go/Rust request fields and binding hash match
acceptance_tests.assert: request_binding_hash identical between Go send and Rust receive

acceptance_tests.test: Rust Worker sends at least one real Heartbeat
Completion returns to correct Flow and WorkItem
acceptance_tests.assert: RespondActivityTaskCompleted returns envelope to correct component

negative_tests.test: Worker returns Committed with no decision_id → not Committed
negative_tests.assert: WorkItem not Committed; Authority verification fails

negative_tests.test: Rust Worker stopped → WorkItem stays Dispatched/Running, NOT error from direct gRPC
negative_tests.assert: proves Matching dispatch, not direct RPC
